description: This file defines classes for iterating over and manipulating SQL query result sets within the vtiger CRM system. It provides an iterator class 'SqlResultIterator' that allows traversal, conversion to array, and access to row data, as well as a 'SqlResultIteratorRow' class for encapsulating individual row data.
external_files: Assumed dependency on database abstraction layer providing methods: num_rows, raw_query_result_rowdata, getFieldsDefinition

classes.name: SqlResultIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing SQL query result sets, with features to convert results into an array and manage iteration state.

classes.name: SqlResultIteratorRow
classes.description: Represents a single row of SQL query result data, providing access to column values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with database connection and result set.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the start.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position points to a valid row.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next row.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current row as an SqlResultIteratorRow object.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current position index of the iterator.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the entire result set into an array of associative arrays.
